provider: InterServer Storage Cloud Compute — 1 TB slices at $3/mo, recurring 'buy 1 get 2 free months'

free_tier.stated: No free tier. Storage VPS costs $3 per month per 1 TB SATA slice (2 GB memory and 2 TB transfer per slice), from 1 slice to 32 slices (32 TB SATA, 64 TB transfer). 11 slices are 11 TB SATA with 22 TB transfer for $33 per month; 22 slices are 22 TB SATA with 44 TB transfer for $66 per month.

egress.terms: 2 TB transfer per 1 TB slice (22 TB with 11 slices, 44 TB with 22 slices) on a 10 Gbps shared port; the page does not state the transfer period.
egress.free_allowance: 2 TB transfer per slice (period not stated on the page)

chaining: The only quasi-repeatable discount here: LET runs 'Buy 1 Get 2 Free' on VPS/Storage VPS roughly quarterly, and the promo is claimed by replying with an order number in the thread — so it recurs on the promo calendar rather than per account. NodeSeek users also report a $2.40/mo 1 TB uncapped variant.
